title.narrative: DCM Georgia Healthcare Group Social Bond

description.narrative: On September 17, 2025, IFC supported the 5-year social bond issuance by Georgia Healthcare Group JSC (GHG or the Company) of GEL350 million with an own account subscription of up to US$20 million in GEL-equivalent as an anchor investor (the IFC Investment). The bond will be listed on the Georgia Stock Exchange. GHG is Georgias leading provider of healthcare services, operating polyclinics, hospitals, and diagnostics businesses.

The most significant expected project-level outcome lies in increasing access to high-quality oncology care in Georgia. Beyond the Project, the IFC Investment is expected to contribute to the development of Georgias capital markets and enable increased adoption of corporate bonds including social bonds.
